SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m') as chartTitle,
DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as chartTitle,
COUNT(*) as num FROM contract WHERE sign_date BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
AND contract_status = #{status}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY chartTitle

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m') as chartTitle,
DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as chartTitle,
SUM(total_amount) as performance FROM contract WHERE sign_date BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
AND contract_status = #{status}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY chartTitle

SELECT c.id, c.contract_no, c.contract_name, c.company_id, cc.company_name, c.opportunity_id, so.opportunity_name, c.owner_id, u.real_name AS owner_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.total_amount, c.contract_status, COALESCE(SUM(pr.payment_amount), 0) AS paid_amount, (c.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pr.payment_amount), 0)) AS remaining_amount, DATEDIFF(c.end_date, NOW()) AS remain_days FROM contract c LEFT JOIN customer_company cc ON cc.id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN sales_opportunity so ON so.id = c.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id LEFT JOIN payment_record pr ON pr.contract_id = c.id AND pr.payment_status = 0 WHERE c.contract_status = 1 AND c.end_date IS NOT NULL AND c.end_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY c.id, cc.company_name, so.opportunity_name, u.real_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.total_amount, c.contract_status ORDER BY remain_days ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.contract_no, c.contract_name, c.company_id, cc.company_name, c.opportunity_id, so.opportunity_name, c.owner_id, u.real_name AS owner_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.total_amount, c.contract_status, COALESCE(SUM(pr.payment_amount), 0) AS paid_amount, (c.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pr.payment_amount), 0)) AS remaining_amount, DATEDIFF(c.end_date, NOW()) AS remain_days FROM contract c LEFT JOIN customer_company cc ON cc.id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN sales_opportunity so ON so.id = c.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id LEFT JOIN payment_record pr ON pr.contract_id = c.id AND pr.payment_status = 0 WHERE c.contract_status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, cc.company_name, so.opportunity_name, u.real_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.total_amount, c.contract_status HAVING (c.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pr.payment_amount), 0)) > 0 AND (COALESCE(c.start_date, c.sign_date) <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) OR (c.end_date IS NOT NULL AND c.end_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY))) ORDER BY remain_days ASC, c.id ASC
